Sync objects between backends or environments with branch management.

This command synchronizes local state with remote repository using Git.
It can pull changes from remote, push local changes, and verify signatures.

Enhanced features:
  - Automatic branch creation based on current priority plan
  - Staging and committing changes in accordance with branch policies
  - Automatic commit message generation based on changes
  - System health check enforcement before commit/push (POL-CODE-004, POL-CODE-005)
  - Pull Request/Merge Request creation (GitHub/GitLab) per priority plan (POL-WORKFLOW-002)

Branch Policy:
  - One feature branch per priority plan (e.g., feature/pri-210-phase-4)
  - Automatically creates branch if it doesn't exist
  - Ensures you're on the correct branch for the current priority plan
  - If no active priority plan exists, branch management is skipped (use --message for commits)

System Health Check (POL-CODE-004, POL-CODE-005):
  - Automatically runs before commit/push operations (enabled by default)
  - Blocks commit/push if Tier 1 (blocking) violations are detected
  - Warns if Tier 2 (warnings) threshold is exceeded (threshold: 0)
  - Use --skip-check to bypass (not recommended)

  Pull changes from remote
  zqk.test system sync --pull
  Stage, commit, and push changes
  zqk.test system sync --stage --commit --push
  Auto-commit with generated message
  zqk.test system sync --auto-commit --push
  Custom commit message
  zqk.test system sync --commit --message "Implement BLI-657 and BLI-659"
  Dry run to see what would happen
  zqk.test system sync --stage --auto-commit --push --dry-run
  Create PR/MR after push
  zqk.test system sync --stage --auto-commit --push --create-pr
  Create PR with custom title and body
  zqk.test system sync --push --create-pr --pr-title "Custom Title" --pr-body "Custom body"

Usage:
  zqk.test system sync [flags]

Flags:
      --auto-commit       Auto-generate commit message and commit
      --commit            Commit staged changes (requires --message or --auto-commit)
      --create-pr         Create Pull Request (GitHub) or Merge Request (GitLab) after push
      --dry-run           Validate without executing
  -F, --force             Skip confirmation
      --message string    Commit message (required if --commit without --auto-commit)
      --pr-body string    PR/MR body (auto-generated from priority plan if not provided)
      --pr-title string   PR/MR title (auto-generated from priority plan if not provided)
      --pull              Pull changes from remote
      --push              Push changes to remote
      --skip-check        Skip system health check (not recommended)
      --stage             Stage all changes
      --verify            Verify signatures

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
